judgement.reason: The self-hosted product is a separate Python API server (mem0) plus a Next.js dashboard server built from different images that must run together, which Deployz cannot run as one service.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares mem0 (builds server/dev.Dockerfile) in server/docker-compose.yaml, which mem0-dashboard needs. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The dashboard is configured to call the mem0 API service at API_INTERNAL_URL, a separate Python service with its own image, and no shown line proves that production does not need it or that it is a supported datastore.
